difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a separable closed point of degree at most d inside the smooth locus of a plane curve over an infinite field (statement lines 1941-1947). The proof (lines 1949-1975) is complete: the chart reduction with the Jacobian argument, the etale projection from a nonempty open, the fibre-degree bound from the y-degree of f, and the rational-point harvest over the infinite base. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a clean etale-projection argument with standard bookkeeping.
